name: kidentify
description: Official k-ID Agent Skills marketplace. Skills for integrating age-appropriate compliance into your app, game, or platform across jurisdictions (COPPA, GDPR-Kids, UK AADC / Online Safety Act, Brazil ECA Digital, Australia Online Safety / social media minimum age).

plugins.name: k-id-skills
plugins.description: k-ID integration skills bundle covering both full sessioned integrations (age gate, consent, age verification, sessions, permissions, webhooks) and standalone AgeKit+ age assurance. Supports both CDK approaches — k-ID widgets (age gate, end-to-end, manage permissions, data notices) and fully custom UX workflows — plus server trust-boundary and mobile-native companion skills.

plugins.name: neimo-skills
plugins.description: neimo. MCP orchestration and visual design skills. Includes neimo-compliance-audit (multi-market regulatory research across COPPA, GDPR-Kids, UK OSA, Brazil ECA Digital, Australia social-media minimum age, and 200+ jurisdictions in the neimo. knowledge base), regulatory-watch (detect regulatory drift in existing compliance artefacts against the neimo. KB with web confirmation), and neimo-design-system (neimo.-styled HTML deliverables across five asset modes: client blueprint, data story, presentation deck, blog diagram, marketing mock). Requires a free neimo. MCP key from neimo.k-id.com/connect.
